sentence: This project measures lipids such as fatty acids, bile acids and steroids using mass spectrometry.
This project looks for the pathways that let long-lasting inflammation worsen atherosclerosis and progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis.
This project studies how enteroviruses spread and infect cells and tissues in animal models, using single-cell transcriptomics and virus population sequencing.
This project develops a cellular immunotherapy to remove unwanted cells or substances from the body, from cancer to drug resistant microbes to amyloid plaques.
This project tests how changes to mRNA and the lipid nanoparticles that carry it help macrophages fight cancer.
This project studies how a chromatin remodeler affects gene regulation and tumor growth in diffuse midline glioma, a deadly disease of children.
This project uses machine learning and peptide screening to build peptides that stay in the eye and lower intraocular pressure for a long time.
This project studies how lung cells that arise after tobacco exposure turn into lung adenocarcinoma, and looks for drugs that target those cells.
This project studies how a family of transcription factors changes the epigenome of macrophages so they respond differently to later stimuli.
This project looks at what blocks the use of CRISPR-based forward genetic screens in mammalian model organisms and plans ways to overcome it.
This project tries to find out how a lipid changes the mechanically gated ion channel in cochlear hair cells.
This project studies how core and secondary parts of the mouse auditory cortex work together to process and learn communication sounds.
This project tests whether injectable biomaterials placed in the heart after a myocardial infarction can improve healing in an animal model.
This project provides statistical and bioinformatics support for cancer research, including data management, analysis and study design.
This project develops an outbred animal model that reliably produces broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV-1, to guide immunogen design.
This project tests treatments for congenital hyperinsulinism by building cell and animal disease models and correcting defects in a potassium channel.
This project maps how immune cells and a virus interact inside infected tissues, to understand how a vaccine stops virus replication.
This project studies how genes, environment and sex lead from good health to obesity-related cardiometabolic disorders, using epigenetic and transcriptional markers.
This project adds an MRI scanner to reduce scheduling delays for research studies that need imaging.
This project screens a library of drug-like molecules to find one that binds and restores a defective inosine triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase protein.
